DOP: pañha m. ( and n. and ~ā, f. ) [ S. praśna], ( iic sometimes pañhā-) question; query, inquiry; controversy, problem; Abh 115; Vin II 300, 13 foll. (sace mayaṃ āyasmantaṃ Revataṃ ~aṃ pucchissāma paṭibalo āyasmā Revato eken’ eva ~ena sakalaṃ pi rattiṃ vītināmetuṃ); V 216, 4 (~ā m’ esā kusalehi cintitā; or ~ā-m-esā?) quoted Sadd 456, 33 ; D I 94, 22 (ayaṃ kho pana te Ambaṭṭha sahadhammiko ~o āgacchati akāmā vyākātabbo); M I 176, 11 (te ~aṃ abhisaṅkharonti imaṃ mayaṃ ~aṃ samaṇaṃ Gotamaṃ upasaṅkamitvā pucchissāma); S II 19, 11 (sace no bhavaṃ Gotamo okāsaṃ karoti ~assa veyyākaraṇāyā ti); A II 46, 6 foll. (atthi bhikkhave ~o ekaṃsavyākaraṇīyo atthi … ~o paṭipucchāvyākaraṇīyo atthi … ~o ṭhapanīyo atthi … ~o vibhajjavyākaraṇīyo); Sn 512 (puccha maṃ Sabhiya ~aṃ yaṃ kiñci manas’ icchasi); 1127 (~ānaṃ veyyākaraṇena tosesi brāhmaṇe muni); 1148 (~ān’ antakaro satthā); Vv 1:4 (~aṃ puṭṭhā viyākāsi yassa kammass’ idaṃ phalaṃ); Ja II 236, 5 (buddhavisayo esa ~o na naṃ añño kathetuṃ sakkhissatī ti); V 140, 17* (Koṇḍañña ~āni viyākarohi) quoted Sadd 457, 1 ; Ja VI 344, 3´ (sukathito paṇḍitena ~o ti); 352, 6* (vikkhittamanā anekacittā ~aṃ na sakkuṇoma vattum etaṃ); Ap 29, 2 (ekaṃ ~aṃ kathento va vimatiṃ chindi pāṇinaṃ); Dukap 241, 30 (imāsu tīsu pi ~āsu); Nett 4, 7* (vissajjitamhi ~e; Nett-a 204, 29 : ~e ti ñātuṃ icchite atthe; quoted Sadd 457, 6 ); Mil 88, 18 (āyasmā Nāgaseno Milindassa rañño ~aṃ vissajjetvā uṭṭhāy’ āsanā saṅghārāmaṃ agamāsi); 95, 16 (ubhatokoṭiko eso ~o); Sp 1174, 25 (ayaṃ hi ~o ukkhittakena kathito, Be, Ce so; Ee, Se ~ā … kathitā); Spk I 141, 1 (nāyaṃ ~o rañño mukhaṃ ulloketvā kathetabbo ti); 327, 5 (aṭṭha ~e saha vissajjanena uggahesuṃ); Kv-a 39, 4 (~asmiṃ); Sadd 456, 30 foll. (°-saddo pulliṅgavasena gahetabbo … katthaci pana itthiliṅgo pi bhavati napuṃsakaliṅgo pi tathā hi ~ā m’ esā kusalehi cintitā, Koṇḍañña ~āni viyākarohī ti taddīpikā pāḷiyo dissanti liṅgavipallāso vā tattha daṭṭhabbo); — ifc see kumārī-, gaṇṭhi-; — ° âbhipuṭṭha , mfn. , asked a question; questioned; M I 210, 11 (tam enaṃ bhagavatā ~ena vyākatan ti, Be, Ee so; Ce, Se taṃ me; Ps II 244, 12 : apuṭṭhen’ eva me na kathitaṃ, bhagavatā pana ~ena pañhaṃ abhipucchitena satā vyākataṃ, Be, Ce, Se so; Ee wr abhipucchantena); — °- kamma , pañhākamma, n. , questioning; a set of questions; Vism 6, 21 (sīlaṃ tāva ārabbha idaṃ ~aṃ hoti, Ce so; Be, Ee, Se pañhā-); Mp I 136, 2 (imassa tāva therassa ~e ayaṃ anupubbikathā, Be, Ce, Ee so; Se pañhā-); Ap-a 114, 23 ; — °- paṭibhāga , n. , a counter-question; a rejoinder; Ja VI 340, 34´ (ken’ idaṃ ~aṃ cintitan ti); — °- paṭibhāna , pañhāpaṭibhāna, n. , an illumination of a problem; the arising of a question; ? D II 352, 11 (api cāhaṃ imāni vicitrāni ~āni sotukāmo, Ce, Ee so; Be, Se pañhā-; Sv 813, 5 : °’-upaṭṭhānāni); M I 83, 10 (apariyādiṇṇaṃ yev’ assa tathāgatassa ~aṃ, Be, Ce, Ee so; Se pañhā-; Ps II 53, 12 : °-vyākaraṇaṃ); Mil 3, 17 (pucchitapucchitaṃ sabbaṃ ~aṃ vijaṭetuṃ nibbeṭhetuṃ samattho); 28, 10 (aticitrāni ~āni vissajjitāni); — °- pucchaka , °-pucchika, mfn. and n. , 1. ( mfn. ) asking a question; who asks questions; Ja II 209, 29 (eko ~o koṇḍo); Nidd I 464, 23 (~ānaṃ, Se so; Ee °-pucchikānaṃ; perhaps wrr; Be, Ce pañhaṃ pucchitukāmānaṃ) = II 102, 5 ( Se pañhāpucchakānaṃ; Be, Ce pañhaṃ pucchitukāmānaṃ; Ee pañhaṃ pucchikāmānaṃ); Spk III 63, 16 (~o bhikkhu, Be, Ce, Se so; Ee pañhā-); — 2. ( n. ) (the section of) the asking of questions; Vibh 69, 34 (~aṃ, Ce so; Be, Ee, Se pañhā-); As 3, 2 (paccayākāre ca ~aṃ natthi); Vibh-a 54, 19 (sabbesu pi ~esu); — °- vīmaṃsaka , m ( fn )., (one) who examines a question, who adjudicates at a debate; Sn 827 (~āse, Ce, Ee so; Be, Se °-vimaṃsakāse, mc; Nidd I 166, 9 : ye te ~ā pārisajjā pāsanikā); Pj II 538, 21 ; — apañha , m. , not the question; a wrong question; Mp II 170, 13 (~am eva pañhan ti kattā hoti); 309, 27 (~o nu kho mayā kathito ti vimatiṃ karoti); — duppañha , m. , a bad or wrong question; Spk II 68, 22 (ayutto pañho, ~o eso ti attho).
